correctness.rationale: For the unit edge source A_p→B_q, let δ_i=1_{i≤t}, m=δ_p+δ_q and C=sum(Y)−sum(X) for the two shores' potentials. Direct Kirchhoff equations give (s−2δ_i)(X_i−Y_i)=1_{i=p}+1_{i=q}+C. Summing gives C=−(s−2+m)/T, and the current to A_aB_b is (1_{a=p}+1_{b=q}+C+δ_a(X_a−Y_a)+δ_b(X_b−Y_b))/s. This reproduces the disjoint-entry formula, including the strict t=2 onset and the reversed matched pair. The endpoints are strict extrema of the potentials since removal of either terminal leaves the graph connected (for s=3 the crown is a cycle; for s≥4 same-shore vertices retain a common neighbor). Kirchhoff then gives total signed current 1 and incident positive mass 2−r_e. Consequently c_e=3−2r_e+2E_e and p_e=c_e+1−2r_e, with the stated extras. Substitution reproduces all four strict incomplete-matching gap comparisons. In the crown, symmetry and trace rank 2s−1 give r_e=(2s−1)/(s(s−1)), and the reverse edge contributes 1/(s(s−1)). These yield the saturated formulas. The monotonicity, final differences and asymptotics follow by subtraction and t/T=O(1/s) uniformly for t<s. Edge symmetry of the matrices equates induced 1 and infinity norms; no minimization over projections is needed.
residual_risks: Replay bounds do not cover general s; the analytical comparisons do. The result only concerns canonical projections for the described matching deletions.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The known cut maximizers and strict diagonal minimum force the same strict cycle maximizers and the cycle norm 4−4R. All crown columns are equivalent and its cycle norm is already stated in the crown record. The two deficits follow by taking differences. For disjoint edges a single substitution in the known kernel indexed by numbers of matched endpoints and reciprocal coincidences gives the frozen formula (2); k=1 gives three explicit values, and k=2 is the already inspected reversed marked pair. This is direct implication even where the sign transition is not separately advertised.

The cycle trajectory and precise disjoint signs follow directly from those full entries, not just from endpoint norms. The full-crown endpoint was also independently covered.
